name: Piano Man
description: Piano Man was a member of the Port Mafia's Flags who was responsible for crafting supernotes. The closest to the position of Mafia executive during his time, he was also the founder and de facto leader of the Flags.

name: Kazuma Utagawa
lightNovelDebut: Osamu Dazai and the Dark Era
description: Kazuma Utagawa is a mafiosi who had been killed during the Dragon's Head Conflict. He was originally an assassin for an enemy syndicate that became a Mafia subsidiary when they were nearly wiped out. Utagawa is survived by his wife and kids, who do not know of his life as an assassin nor his association with the Mafia.

name: Kurehito Umeki
lightNovelDebut: Osamu Dazai and the Dark Era
description: Kurehito Umeki is a mafiosi who had been killed during the Dragon's Head Conflict. He was a former military police officer who was stigmatized and kicked out of the force for allegedly killing his colleague. He joined the Mafia soon after and proved to be a skilled leader in battle.

name: Miroku Ishige
lightNovelDebut: Osamu Dazai and the Dark Era
description: Miroku Ishige is a mafiosi who had been killed during the Dragon's Head Conflict. Miroku was a former sex worker who had been caring for her sick parents. Her poor eyesight but excellent hearing allowed her to hear the enemies coming before attacking, which played a huge role in the survival of other Mafia members.

name: Shōkichi Saegusa
lightNovelDebut: Osamu Dazai and the Dark Era
description: Shōkichi Saegusa is a mafiosi who had been killed during the Dragon's Head Conflict. Nothing is known about his personality except that according to Ango, he had a way of calming situations down and was apparently loved by the shop owners in the turf.

name: Port Mafia's Previous Boss
japaneseName: ポートマフィアの先代首領
description: He was the unnamed previous boss whom Ōgai Mori succeeded in the Port Mafia eight years ago. During his years, Yokohama had became a violent city. Eventually, he fell to sickness and got bedridden. Later on, he was killed by Mori.
